messages:
Zara Li: Morning folks  Orchid Analytics wants a 15-seat beta starting Apr 5. Their asks: clear activation goals, a simple telemetry hook, and a renewal signal if adoption stalls.
Riley (Orchid Analytics): Hi Zara  we can provide 3 PMs + 4 analysts. Prefer an early-morning kickoff. Also want a short checklist for redacting proprietary content.
Zara Li: @Marco can you own telemetry + dashboard? Need per-seat daily tokens, p95 latency, and an 'engaged' flag (>=2 queries/day).
Marco Chen: Will do. I'll create tag `orchid_beta`, a Grafana panel (active_seats, tokens/d, p95), and provide a tiny event example.
Ivy Patel: I'll handle enablement. Plan: 30m goals, 60m hands-on, 20m troubleshooting + prompt tuning tips. I'll include a one-pager 'cost vs quality' to help their PMs.
onboard-bot: New intake  docs: Zara Li, infra: Marco Chen, enablement: Ivy Patel, legal: intake-team.
Marco Chen: Instrumentation snippet to share:
```
curl -X POST https://telemetry.redwood.ai/v1/events \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"customer":"orchid","user_id":"u_42","model":"redwood-v2","tokens":200,"lat_ms":130,"event":"query"}'
```
Marco Chen: I'll add cost_per_1k_tokens and a CSV export for weekly billing estimates.
Zara Li: Risk: they said renewal is unlikely if <40% active seats by day 7. Let's plan an aggressive nudge sequence and a power-user interview by day 10.
Ivy Patel: Proposed cadence: Day 1 kickoff, Day 3 quick tips + prompt pack, Day 6 adoption push (examples + office hours), Day 9 power-user 1:1, Day 13 renewal prep. I'll draft short in-channel nudges.
Riley (Orchid Analytics): That cadence works. Also can you surface anonymized example of 'unexpected outputs' so we can tune prompts? We'll send a sample dataset (sanitized).
Marco Chen: We'll provide sanitized examples and a redaction checklist. Also setting alert `orchid_low_activation` (active_seats < 6 for 48h) and `orchid_high_latency` (p95 > 600ms).
Zara Li: Action list: Marco  telemetry + dashboard + alerts by Apr 3. Ivy  enablement deck, nudges, and power-user interview template by Apr 2. Zara  send kickoff invite for Apr 5 8:30am PT and attach success metrics doc.
Ivy Patel: I'll also prepare a 1-page 'when to escalate to SE' checklist for cases where retrieval or hallucination issues appear.
Riley (Orchid Analytics): Thanks all  we'll send SAML metadata and the sanitized dataset by Tue EOD.
Zara Li: Saving this thread as the source of truth for Orchid beta intake. Will update with links once dashboard and docs are live. :sparkles:
